title: Output summary update
statement: Define an update on the three summary states $0,1,2$ for an optional Boolean output. From state $0$, no output leaves the state at $0$, outputting true changes it to $1$, and outputting false changes it to $2$; from state $1$, no output leaves it at $1$ and either Boolean output changes it to $2$; state $2$ remains $2$ for every output.
